patent_grounding.rationale: Reviewed all distinct cited patent passages. Frame/support pivot via connector 208, frame pivot pins for links, jaws and sliding/pivoting mounts, springs, pallet interaction, operating modes and vehicle context are supported. No material unsupported patent fact identified.

functional_completeness.rationale: Core components and behaviors relevant to the selected clamp scope are represented, including separate clamp support and paired link mounts. No further omission warrants a finding at this abstraction.

flow_consistency.rationale: Modeled physical interfaces pair compatible mechanical-motion or mechanical-force endpoints and use descriptive flow types. The support pivot and link pivot attachments are not transformation interfaces.

claim_traceability.rationale: Patent-supported functions/components are cited. No invented quantitative requirement is present; claims need not be represented as requirements.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook guidance informs systems/function modeling distinctions only; patent passages, not textbook material, support invention facts.

summary: Independently reviewed saved revision 8 and read all cited distinct patent passages plus relevant textbook guidance. The previously flagged duplicate frame-to-clamp-support interface is corrected: the connection is recorded once. Distinct pivot-link mounting endpoints are also represented by separate frame ports, each mated to its corresponding link port, consistent with the cited disclosure of pivot links on pins fixed to and extending from the support frame. No remaining issue identified in the reviewed topology or model.
